Definition: Type 2 task agent that aggregates information across sets of files for human-defined purposes.
Collating deliverable-level estimate artifacts into a coherent project-level estimate package.
Control surface used to invoke or brief AGGREGATION.
Aggregation output root that defaults to {EXECUTION_ROOT}/_Aggregation/.
Root that defaults to execution/ relative to the repo or project root.
Primary outputs under {AGGREGATION_ROOT}/; each run writes a new snapshot folder and never overwrites prior snapshots.
Pointer files may be overwritten to reference the latest snapshot.
Provenance value preserved for every aggregated record.
Best-effort section provenance preserved with SourcePath, or location TBD.
Basis selection and evidence captured for each deliverable.
Usable detail table required for inclusion in totals.
Artifact that records coverage gaps and accurately reports missing or invalid artifacts.
Coverage status with values OK, OK_WITH_WARNINGS, SCHEMA_INVALID, or MISSING_DETAIL.
Stable detail key in the form {FromDeliverableID}::{LineID}.
Stable assumption key in the form {FromDeliverableID}::{AssumptionID} when assumptions have IDs.
Stable risk key in the form {FromDeliverableID}::{RiskID} when risks have IDs.
Deliverable identifier used in artifact selection and record key namespaces.
Preferred artifact for BASIS_OF_ESTIMATE and supporting notes or references.
Supporting audit context and Estimate Collation output for WBS/CBS mapping.
Snapshot artifact used to record instruction conflicts, defaults, tie-breaks, and column mapping behavior.
